title: Earthborne Rangers
subtitle: A customizable cooperative card game of open-world wilderness adventure and ecological stewardship
tagline: Answer the call of the Valley, forage new paths, and protect the living wilderness
loreSummary: Centuries after civilization transformed the world, humanity thrives in harmony with nature in a breathtaking wilderness. As a Ranger, you are sworn to explore the Valley, assist its communities, and preserve its fragile ecological balance.
keyFeatures: Vibrant open-world exploration where every play session represents an in-game Day
Dynamic living card ecosystem featuring wildlife, terrain obstacles, and local factions
Character deck customization that evolves persistently across missions and rewards
Non-linear branching narrative guided by the comprehensive Living Valley storybook

ebr_standard.name: Standard Valley Campaign
ebr_standard.description: The quintessential ranger expedition covering major regional storylines, pivotal community requests, and crucial wilderness discoveries across ~21 game days.

ebr_story.name: Focused Trailway (Core Arcs)
ebr_story.description: A streamlined narrative trek prioritizing primary Valley crises and direct story missions across ~15 game days.

ebr_full_valley.name: Master Ranger (Complete Valley Chronicle)
ebr_full_valley.description: An exhaustive expedition charting every distant corner, mountain pass, side mission, and hidden mystery across the entire 30-day campaign calendar.

milestones.title: First Steps Beyond the Haven
milestones.phase: Valley Exploration Phase I - The Outer Trails
milestones.description: Venturing out from the ancestral refuge, mastering the trail ways, and securing initial alliances among the Valley folk.

milestones.title: Echoes of the Ancestors
milestones.phase: Valley Exploration Phase II - Ancient Mysteries
milestones.description: Uncovering forgotten technology and ancient ruins nestled within the untamed wilds, guiding new paths forward.

milestones.title: The Deep Wilderness
milestones.phase: Valley Exploration Phase III - Across the Ridge
milestones.description: Traversing hazardous terrain and high mountain reaches to resolve mounting ecological tensions and hidden perils.

milestones.title: Harmony in the Living Valley
milestones.phase: Valley Exploration Phase IV - Legacy of the Rangers
milestones.description: Fulfilling the Rangers' sworn duty to protect and preserve the delicate balance between community, flora, and fauna.
